knowledge:
- key_parameters: norm=Specifies the normalization method (e.g., "p" for print-tip loess normalization) ;; n=Specifies the plate size (e.g., 384 or 96 wells) in maCompPlate ;; targets=An marrayInfo object containing target sample information ;; path=The directory path containing the data files ;; xvar=The variable to plot on the x-axis (e.g., "maPrintTip") ;; yvar=The variable to plot on the y-axis (e.g., "maM")
- alternatives: None mentioned in the provided documentation
- when_to_use: When analyzing raw two-color (dual-channel) microarray data to perform quality control, diagnostic plotting, and normalization (such as print-tip loess)
- pitfalls: Attempting to perform scale normalization (maNormScale) without first performing location normalization (maNorm), or forgetting to assign plate metadata (maCompPlate) before downstream plate-level diagnostics

workflows.name: two_color_microarray_preprocessing
workflows.intent: Load raw two-color microarray data, assign layout and plate metadata, perform diagnostic plotting, and normalize intensity data.
input: SwirlSample.txt (targets file describing samples and dye assignments)
fish.gal (Gene Pix Array List file containing layout and gene names)
Spot/raw intensity files (raw data files in the specified directory)
workflows.stages: 1. Read target information ;; 2. Read raw intensity data ;; 3. Read layout and gene information from GAL file and assign to raw object ;; 4. Compute and assign plate metadata ;; 5. Perform pre-normalization diagnostic plotting ;; 6. Normalize intensity data ;; 7. Perform post-normalization diagnostic plotting
workflows.code:
datadir <- system.file("swirldata", package="marray")
swirlTargets <- read.marrayInfo(file.path(datadir, "SwirlSample.txt"))
mraw <- read.Spot(targets = swirlTargets, path=datadir)
galinfo <- read.Galfile("fish.gal", path=datadir)
mraw@maLayout <- galinfo$layout
mraw@maGnames <- galinfo$gnames
maPlate(swirl)<-maCompPlate(swirl,n=384)
boxplot(swirl[,3], xvar="maPrintTip", yvar="maM", main="Swirl array 93: pre--normalization")
boxplot(swirl, yvar="maM", main="Swirl arrays: pre--normalization")
plot(swirl[,3], main="Swirl array 93: pre--normalization MA--plot")
swirl.norm <- maNorm(swirl, norm="p")
summary(swirl.norm)
swirl.norm1 <- maNorm(swirl, norm="p")
swirl.norm2 <- maNormScale(swirl.norm1, norm="p")
boxplot(swirl.norm[,3], xvar="maPrintTip", yvar="maM", main="Swirl array 93: post--normalization")
boxplot(swirl.norm, yvar="maM", main="Swirl arrays: post--normalization")
plot(swirl.norm[,3], main="Swirl array 93: post--normalization MA--plot")
